test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On 20 June 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi officially flagged off India’s first indigenously manufactured locomotive export to which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Republic of Guinea**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• On **20 June 2025**, Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** flagged off India's first **indigenously manufactured locomotive export**.
 
• The country receiving this export is the **Republic of Guinea**, a West African nation with growing trade relations with India.
 
• The locomotive was manufactured by **Indian Railways' Production Units**, showcasing India's capability to produce high-quality rail technology domestically.
 
• The initiative marks a significant milestone in India's "Make in India" campaign and its efforts to become a global exporter of advanced technology and infrastructure equipment.
 
• This export strengthens the **bilateral relationship** between India and the Republic of Guinea, contributing to the African nation's infrastructure development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Railways' Manufacturing Capabilities:**

 
 
• Indian Railways operates several **production units**, such as the **Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW)**, Diesel Locomotive Works (DLW), and Modern Coach Factory (MCF).
 
• These units specialize in manufacturing **electric locomotives, diesel locomotives, and high-speed coaches** for domestic and international markets.
 
• India's locomotive exports highlight the country's ability to meet global quality standards and deliver cost-effective solutions.
 
 
 
• **Republic of Guinea:**
 
 
• The Republic of Guinea is located in **West Africa**, bordered by countries like Senegal, Mali, and Sierra Leone.
 
• It is rich in **bauxite reserves** and other natural resources, making it a significant trade partner for India.
 
• India has been fostering bilateral relations with Guinea through trade, developmental assistance, and capacity-building programs.
 
 
 
• **Make in India Campaign:**
 
 
• Launched in **2014** by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the "Make in India" initiative aims to make India a global manufacturing hub.
 
• The campaign focuses on enhancing infrastructure, streamlining processes, and encouraging foreign direct investment (FDI) in key sectors.
 
• The export of locomotives aligns with the campaign's goals, showcasing India's growing manufacturing and technological capabilities.
 
 
 
• **India-Africa Relations:**
 
 
• India is actively engaged in enhancing its partnership with African nations through initiatives such as the **India-Africa Forum Summit**.
 
• Key areas of cooperation include **infrastructure development, energy, health, and education**.
 
• The locomotive export is part of India's broader strategy to strengthen ties with Africa and contribute to its economic growth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The locomotive export is a **first-of-its-kind initiative** for India, reinforcing its status as a global supplier of advanced rail technology.
 
• The Republic of Guinea is expected to utilize these locomotives for enhancing its **railway infrastructure**, boosting trade and connectivity within the region.
 
• India's expertise in manufacturing cost-effective and efficient rail solutions makes it a preferred partner for developing nations.
 
• The success of this export is likely to open up new opportunities for India's railway sector in other **global markets**, especially in Africa and Asia.
